content:
ajay: Heads up, seeing a bunch of GPU nodes in us-central1-b flapping to NotReady/NoSchedule after tonight's kernel roll. device-plugin logs show handshake timeout and repeated hostprobe failures.

deploy-bot: completed rolling kernel update for nodepool gpu-preemptible-01 at 22:12 UTC :white_check_mark:

maya: can you paste `kubectl get nodes -o wide` and the device-plugin pod logs?

ajay: here's snippet from `kubectl get nodes`:

```
NAME                                       STATUS       ROLES   AGE     VERSION
gpubox-1                                   NotReady     <none>  15h     v1.25.4
gpubox-2                                   NotReady     <none>  15h     v1.25.4
gpubox-preempt-3                           Ready        <none>  2h      v1.25.4
```

ajay: device-plugin logs (kube-system/nvidia-device-plugin):

```
E0321 22:16:09.123 1 device_plugin.go:234] handshake timeout waiting for kubelet
E0321 22:16:10.456 1 hostprobe.go:78] hostprobe failed: dial unix /var/lib/nvidia/hostprobe.sock: connect: no such file or directory
W0321 22:16:11.789 1 backoff.go:45] retrying in 30s
```

sophia: we're seeing handshake backoff plus hostprobe socket missing. Could be kernel/NVIDIA module mismatch after the image change. Any recent driver upgrades?

lewis: cluster-autoscaler is also stuck because these nodes are tainted NoSchedule and CA sees no schedulable capacity. Autoscaler logs show scaleDown disabled due to NotReady nodes older than 10m.

oncall-sre: @ajay @maya, can someone try restarting kubelet on one affected node and restarting the device-plugin daemonset pods? quick checks:
`sudo systemctl restart kubelet` 
`kubectl delete pod -n kube-system -l app=nvidia-device-plugin --now`

ajay: tried restarts, device-plugin pods crashloop with hostprobe missing. `modprobe nvidia` on host shows version mismatch: modinfo reports 525.60 but driver package expects 530.x

maya: rollback plan: pin node image to previous kernel / driver combination, or re-install matching NVIDIA driver. Which is faster? Preemptible pool so reboots are cheap.

sophia: short fix — disable hostprobe in device plugin to let pods register (not ideal), set device-plugin flag `--no-host-probe` and increase handshake timeout `--kubelet-max-timeout=60s`. We'll do that on kube-system for quick recovery and then do proper rollback.

ajay: patched daemonset with `--no-host-probe --kubelet-max-timeout=60s` and restarted. nodes moved to Ready within ~2m. :relieved:

lewis: cluster-autoscaler started scaling normally again. cost impact minimal because preemptible churn didn't trigger large scale-ups.

ajay: creating follow-up ticket INFRA-2345 to standardize driver-image matrix and add preflight check to nodepool rollout. leaving oncall notes and a retrospective.

infra-bot: created ticket INFRA-2345 and assigned to eng-infra.

maya: nice work. we'll add a nodepool rollout step to run `modinfo nvidia` and device-plugin smoke test before marking as done.

ajay: thanks everyone. closing thread for now. :thumbsup:
